articles.title: Google alternative Kagi launches an email service
articles.essence: Kagi, which already offers a paid alternative to Google Search and its own Orion browser as a rival to Chrome, is taking on another Google service: Gmail. articles.title: The hacker behind early GTA VI leaks has been sentenced — and released
articles.essence: Arion Kurtaj, who pleaded guilty last week to hacking Grand Theft Auto VI developer Rockstar Games and other companies, including Uber and Revolut, was sentenced to seven years in prison but released on license, the BBC reports. After hacking Rockstar, Kurtaj leaked 90 videos of GTA VI in 2022, years before the game's public release […]

articles.title: The Verge’s 2026 holiday gift guide
articles.essence: Gift-giving isn't just about grabbing something solid under a determined spending limit. It's an expression of love, a way to show someone how well you really know them.
articles.full_body: Gift-giving isn't just about grabbing something solid under a determined spending limit. It's an expression of love, a way to show someone how well you really know them. articles.title: Ladybird, the first new browser engine in years, is now available to test
articles.essence: Ladybird, an independent web browser with a built-from-scratch engine, is finally available for testing. On Monday, Ladybird developer Andreas Kling announced that the browser is launching in alpha on macOS and Linux following more than four years of development.
